projects.title: SpeakNow
projects.summary: SpeakNow is an AI-powered public speaking platform that helps people practice speeches and get detailed feedback on their performance.
bullets: Analyzes recorded speeches and gives feedback on delivery, pacing, clarity, and overall performance.
Uses a panel of 6 AI judges to evaluate each speech from different perspectives and create a detailed report.
Built an end-to-end system for recording, analysis, scoring, feedback, and progress tracking.
projects.closing: Built to make high-quality speaking feedback available anytime you want to practice.
projects.oneliner: Practice speeches in front of a panel of 6 AI judges and get a scored report.

projects.title: Aegis
projects.summary: Aegis is a maritime safety and anomaly detection platform that tracks vessel activity and identifies suspicious behavior in real time.
bullets: Uses live AIS data to track vessels, detect identity changes, and flag dark-vessel activity.
Built predictive tracking with Kalman filtering and 600-run Monte Carlo simulations to estimate where vessels are heading.
Detects geofence violations and compares predicted movement against actual vessel behavior to surface risk alerts.
projects.closing: Built to turn complex maritime data into clear, actionable safety alerts.
projects.oneliner: Tracks ships in real time and flags dark vessels and suspicious behavior.

projects.title: GhostThread
projects.summary: GhostThread is an AI agent that turns team feedback into actionable development work across the tools teams already use.
bullets: Connects Slack, Gmail, GitHub, and Linear to find feedback and turn it into development tasks.
Won 1st Place in AI Agents and 2× 1st Place in DevTools at Agents Love You 2.
Automatically creates Linear tickets, makes code changes, and pushes updates to GitHub.
projects.closing: Built to turn scattered feedback into shipped improvements with less manual work.
projects.oneliner: AI agent that turns team feedback into tickets, code changes, and PRs.

projects.title: ChancifyAI
projects.summary: ChancifyAI helps students better understand their chances of getting into college using AI and real admissions data.
bullets: Built predictions using real college admissions data to give students personalized acceptance estimates.
Reached 350+ users and placed 4th in the 2026 Congressional App Challenge.
Built college search, profile analysis, admissions predictions, and an AI college assistant.
projects.closing: Built to make the college admissions process simpler and less confusing.
projects.oneliner: Personalized college acceptance odds built on real admissions data.

projects.title: Meteor Madness
projects.summary: Meteor Madness is an interactive platform that uses real NASA asteroid data to explore potential asteroid impacts and their effects on Earth.
bullets: Uses NASA data to analyze asteroid size, speed, trajectory, and potential impact risk.
Built an interactive 3D simulation to visualize asteroid impacts and their effects on different locations.
Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge using real-world space and planetary data.
projects.closing: Built to turn complex asteroid data into something anyone can explore and understand.
projects.oneliner: 3D asteroid impact simulator powered by real NASA data.
